name: 删除倒计时
desc: 点删除后 5 秒倒计时（pending 样式 / 逐秒文案 / 图标 mdi:reply / 仍计入统计）、再点撤销、到点进垃圾桶、垃圾桶还原回列表、刷新后落盘；5 秒等待用宿主数值 wait 步骤，就绪轮询放在 eval 里

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); return T.click(Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === t)); }; T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.items = () => T.q('.item'); T.item = (t) => T.items().find((i) => T.tx(i.querySelector('.text')) === t) || null; T.need = (t) => { const i = T.item(t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-field'), desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(400); return true; }; T.view = (t) => T.click(T.q('st-button-group st-button').find((b) => T.tx(b).indexOf(t) === 0)); T.delBtn = (t) => Array.from(T.need(t).querySelectorAll('.item-actions st-icon-button'))[1]; T.del = (t) => T.click(T.delBtn(t)); T.itemBtn = (t, label) => T.click(Array.from(T.need(t).querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === label)); return 'helpers ready';
await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); await T.addTask('任务A', ''); await T.addTask('任务B', ''); if (T.items().length !== 2) throw new Error('应有 2 条任务，实际 ' + T.items().length); return 'ok';

T.del('任务A'); await T.wait(500); const i = T.need('任务A'); if (i.className.indexOf('pending') === -1) throw new Error('倒计时中应带 pending 类：' + i.className); const meta = T.tx(i.querySelector('.meta')); if (meta.indexOf('秒后移入垃圾桶') === -1) throw new Error('副标题应显示倒计时：' + meta); const b = T.delBtn('任务A'); if (b.querySelector('n-icon').getAttribute('icon') !== 'mdi:reply') throw new Error('倒计时中图标应为 mdi:reply'); if (b.getAttribute('title') !== '撤销删除') throw new Error('倒计时中按钮 title 应为「撤销删除」，实际 ' + b.getAttribute('title')); const f = T.tx(T.q('.footer .count')[0]); if (f !== '2 项未完成 · 共 2 项') throw new Error('倒计时中的条目仍应计入统计：' + f); return 'ok';

T.del('任务A'); await T.wait(500); const i = T.need('任务A'); if (i.className.indexOf('pending') !== -1) throw new Error('撤销后不应再有 pending 类'); const meta = T.tx(i.querySelector('.meta')); if (meta.indexOf('秒后') !== -1) throw new Error('撤销后不应再显示倒计时：' + meta); if (T.delBtn('任务A').querySelector('n-icon').getAttribute('icon') !== 'mdi:close') throw new Error('撤销后图标应回到 mdi:close'); if (T.items().length !== 2) throw new Error('撤销后条目应保留'); return 'ok';
T.del('任务B'); await T.wait(400); if (T.need('任务B').className.indexOf('pending') === -1) throw new Error('「任务B」应进入倒计时'); return 'deleted';

await T.ready('.shell'); if (T.item('任务B')) throw new Error('倒计时结束后条目应离开列表'); if (T.items().length !== 1) throw new Error('列表应剩 1 条，实际 ' + T.items().length); const labels = T.q('st-button-group st-button').map((b) => T.tx(b)); if (labels.indexOf('垃圾桶 1') === -1) throw new Error('垃圾桶标签应带数量：' + labels); T.view('垃圾桶'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 1) throw new Error('垃圾桶应有 1 条，实际 ' + T.items().length); const i = T.need('任务B'); if (i.className.indexOf('trash') === -1) throw new Error('垃圾桶条目应带 trash 类：' + i.className); const meta = T.tx(i.querySelector('.meta')); if (meta.indexOf('删除于') === -1 || meta.indexOf('创建于') === -1) throw new Error('垃圾桶副标题应含删除与创建时间：' + meta); return 'ok';

T.itemBtn('任务B', '还原'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 0) throw new Error('还原后垃圾桶应为空'); T.view('全部'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 2) throw new Error('还原后列表应有 2 条，实际 ' + T.items().length); const meta = T.tx(T.need('任务B').querySelector('.meta')); if (meta.indexOf('默认 · 创建于') !== 0) throw new Error('还原后副标题应回到创建时间：' + meta); const labels = T.q('st-button-group st-button').map((b) => T.tx(b)); if (labels.indexOf('垃圾桶') === -1) throw new Error('垃圾桶徒标应消失：' + labels); return 'ok';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.item')); if (items.length !== 2) throw new Error('刷新后列表应有 2 条（还原已落盘），实际 ' + items.length); if (root.querySelectorAll('.item.trash').length !== 0) throw new Error('刷新后垃圾桶应为空'); if (!items.some((i) => i.querySelector('.text').textContent.trim() === '任务B')) throw new Error('刷新后找不到 任务B'); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
